news.text: #Spalletti and #JuveThe grace period is over#Carnevali: " I am not one that makes changes". But #Conte...[Front Page Gazzetta dello Sport]
"I'M NOT REPLACING #SPALLETTI"#Carnevali locks down #JuveThe KO against #Sassuolo and #Conte invoked on social media by the fans. "Time is needed here".[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#JUVE SHAKE-UPA 3-man defense, a reinforced midfield, one less attacking midfielder.#Spalletti lectures the team in front of the directors. The message: we cannot move forward like this, we even need to change the attitude. The recovery of #McKennie and #Cambiaso are fundamental for the 3-4-2-1. #Carnevali: "#Conte? I'm not even thinking about it. We need to plan, not make changes". [Front Page TuttoSport]

#Alajbegovic does not have any physical issues: he went off because he was having trouble with his contact lenses and couldn't see well under the strong stadium lights. @Sportmania_24[Michele De Blasis]

‼️EXCL.#Juventus is continuing to show interest in the French attacking winger Rossè #Torres (16 years old) from #Nice. Initial contacts between the parties already took place last August.[Mirko Di Natale]

Breaking and exclusiveJuventus are closing in on Atleti's Amaiur Sarriegi as a replacement for the injured Ana Capeta. The 2000-born Spanish forward scored against Juventus in the previous Champions League campaign[MauMunno]

Giovanni #Carnevali to Radio Rai: “We cannot think that #Juventus has become a lower-level club than what it is. A return of #Conte in place of #Spalletti? I am absolutely not thinking about it!”. #calciomercato[Nico Schira]

🤵‍♂️🗣 Giovanni #Carnevali to 'Rai Radio 1':DEFEAT - "If we look at the result, it is certainly negative. We made several mistakes that #Juventus cannot make, despite creating chances. It is part of the growth process of the team and the club. We tried to win at all costs thereby losing our balance against a strong team like #Sassuolo. On a positive note, I see the spirit of trying to get the result at all costs: I hope this defeat serves as a lesson, the blame does not just lie with the defense but with all of us".#SPALLETTI - "#Spalletti is an extraordinary coach, one of the absolute best. Changing coaches is not in my nature, we must try and build, we need to give it time and have patience

Defeats away at #Sassuolo at the beginning of the season have historically always brought out the character of #Juventus and led to a winning streak (look at 2015 and 2023). Now a strong reaction will be needed, because #Juve must go back to tearing their opponents apart.[Mirko Di Natale]

🚨⚪️⚫️ Juventus CEO Carnevali: “We are not planning any change of manager. Luciano Spalletti is an extraordinary coach”.“Changing the coach is not part of my usual plans”, told Radio Anch’io lo sport.[Fabrizio Romano]

🇫🇷🧐 "There had been talks of #Juventus for #Bakola, but it was never a serious negotiation: for #Sassuolo he was always considered non-transferable - it wasn't a matter of money, but strictly about the opportunity. Whether he is being monitored is a separate issue: the bianconero management always keeps an eye on talented players like him, but at the moment it stops here."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇲🇪👀 "For #Adzic, there was an important offer from Germany, but #Juventus chose not to consider it, not to cash in on him and send him on a controlled loan to #Sassuolo for €500,000 + a €12M option to buy + a €1.7M counter-option to eventually bring him back. The management is very pleased with his start: I believe this is a buy-back clause on which they already have very clear ideas for the future."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇽🇰🆙 "#Zhegrova stayed because no solution was found on the mercato. #Lazio was never a serious option, while #Atalanta consisted it, but an agreement on the formula was never reached. There was also the #AlIttihad option, but they made other choices. This was the reasoning that led to his exclusion from the UEFA list: the management was convinced they would manage to sell him, but they didn't succeed."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
